map.输入首期现金流 C、贴现率 r、增长率 g、期数 n，求增长年金现值。: Enter the first-period cash flow C, discount rate r, growth rate g and number of periods n to find the present value of a growing annuity.
map.C=100,r=5%,g=2%,n=10 → 约 840 元。: C=100, r=5%, g=2%, n=10 gives about 840 CNY.
map.PV=C÷(r−g)×[1−((1+g)/(1+r))^n]，C 首期现金流、r: PV = C / (r-g) x [1 - ((1+g)/(1+r))^n], where C is the first-period cash flow, r the discount rate, g the growth rate and n the number of periods. r > g is required, otherwise the present value diverges and the formula fails.

map.增长率能超过贴现率吗？: Can the growth rate exceed the discount rate?
map.不能。增长年金公式要求 r>g，否则现值发散、公式失效。若 g≥r 需用永续或其: No. The growing annuity formula requires r > g, otherwise the present value diverges and the formula fails. If g >= r, a perpetuity or another model must be used with care.
map.和永续增长年金什么关系？: What is the relation to a growing perpetuity?
map.有限期 n 的增长年金是永续版 PV=C÷(r−g) 减去第 n 期后的尾值现值: A growing annuity of finite term n is the perpetuity version PV = C/(r-g) minus the present value of the tail after period n, which is the [1 - ((1+g)/(1+r))^n] correction term in the formula.
